ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; surface is dominated by low-intensity (black/dark-gray) pixels (>95%) with localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters at the distal tips and specific surface anomalies.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity region across both lobes. High-intensity, high-texture clusters are localized at the distal tips. A single high-intensity linear vector is located on the mid-right lobe. Scattered high-intensity pixels are visible at the ventral base near the water line.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped depression with an internal angle of approximately 55 degrees; the depth is roughly 15% of the visible vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The trailing edge is highly irregular. The right lobe exhibits several high-amplitude, jagged notches (structural voids), while the left lobe shows a higher frequency of lower-amplitude serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The visible leading edges follow a continuous convex mathematical curve from the base towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast, roughly circular textured pixel clusters located at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent, high-contrast white linear mark (approx. 50-60 pixels in length) on the right lobe, oriented diagonally; several smaller, less defined linear disruptions near the central fluke base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular notches and structural loss along the trailing edge of the right lobe; heavy textured encrustations at the tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced morphological asymmetry between the jagged trailing edge of the right lobe and the relatively smoother serrated edge of the left lobe.
